newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's Amen Bank has higher '96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's Amen Bank has higher '96 profit.

text.p: Tunisia's Amen Bank, the country's single fully privately-owned bank, made a 7.93 million dinars post-tax net profit in 1996, up by 9.47 percent from 7.24 million dinars in 1995, final results showed on Friday.
The bank said it will distribute a five percent ordinary dividend and an additional five percent super divided.

Clients deposits in 1996 rose 34 percent to 601 million dinars compared to their level the previous year. Amen's bank share of total deposits in all Tunisian banks rose to 8.2 percent from 6.9 percent, the annual report to shareholders said.
Turnover was 76.7 million dinars, up 17.6 percent compared to its level the previous year.
Cash flow was 22.8 million dinars, up 29 percent compared to 17.6 million dinars in 1995.
Total balance sheet at the end of 1996 stood at 892.54 million dinars, up 18.28 percent compared to 754.59 million dinars.
Amen Bank had a 40 millions dinars capital and 25 million dinars reserves at end-1996. ($=1.1014 dinar)
